description: Connect this AI to the user's MARU wallet (Japanese yen stablecoin, JPYC). The user creates a one-time pairing code in the MARU app (Security > Let AI pay > Add an AI) and tells it to you. Returns an agent token and a 4-symbol fingerprint: tell the user the fingerprint and ask them to approve this AI in the MARU app with Face ID. Until they approve, the token does nothing. Keep the token for later calls; never show it to anyone else.

agent_name.description: A short name the user will recognise in their app, e.g. 'Claude (work laptop)'.

pairing_code.description: Code shown in the MARU app, like ABCD-2345. Valid for 10 minutes, usable once.

name: maru_wallet_connect
title: Connect to a MARU wallet
